moltoken_editor.order: pre-oracle generation order; cf_row_id may be used only after provenance verification
moltoken_editor.refill: not applicable unless a predefined deterministic candidate-expansion rule is required

reinvent4_mol2mol.candidate_pool: unique valid candidates from the formal seed
reinvent4_mol2mol.refill: only parents with fewer than five candidates; use derived sub-seeds and retain the first five unique valid candidates without property-oracle selection

mmp_transformer_single_logd.refill: not used when the base run already provides five unique valid candidates; otherwise apply the same predefined minimal oracle-independent refill rule

seed_handling: Each stochastic seed is evaluated independently. Candidates from different seeds must not be pooled before Top-K selection.
important_prohibitions: Do not select the five candidates using logD predictions.
Do not pool candidates across random seeds.
Do not duplicate candidates to reach five.
Do not relax chemical validity after viewing results.
Do not use the MMP refill-to-50 pool in the common-budget analysis.
